description: This file defines several exported functions for moderation-related actions via API calls, including listing flagged items, performing moderation actions, and flagging content within a web application.

methods.name: listFlagged(params)
methods.description: Fetches a list of flagged items with optional parameters.

methods.name: moderateAction(ids, action, note)
methods.description: Performs a moderation action on specified items with an action type and note.
